name: Shiva
blessing: Har Har Mahadev. May peace and strength guide your day.

name: Hanuman
blessing: Bajrang Bali ki kripa se aapka din shubh ho.

name: Krishna
blessing: Radhe Krishna. May joy and compassion stay close today.

name: Ganesh
blessing: Ganpati Bappa Morya. May your path open with wisdom.

name: Durga
blessing: Maa Durga ki shakti aapke saath bani rahe.

name: Lakshmi
blessing: Maa Lakshmi bless your home with peace and abundance.

name: Ram
blessing: Jai Shri Ram. May courage and maryada shape your day.
defaultMantra: श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम
